entries.name: EBAY_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: The App ID (client id) of an eBay developer app the store owns, from its production keyset, or its sandbox keyset when EBAY_ENVIRONMENT is sandbox. Not a secret on its own.
howToGet: Sign in to developer.ebay.com with the store's own developer account and open Application Keys.
Create a keyset for production (and one for the sandbox to test with) and copy its App ID (Client ID).

entries.name: EBAY_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.description: The Cert ID (client secret) of the same keyset. It goes only to eBay's token endpoint, in a Basic header.
howToGet: In Application Keys, copy the keyset's Cert ID (Client Secret).
Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: EBAY_REFRESH_TOKEN
entries.description: The refresh token from the store's eBay seller account agreeing to the app with only the scope https://api.ebay.com/oauth/api_scope/sell.fulfillment.readonly. Brain A asks for every access token with that scope alone, so eBay turns down any change. It lasts 18 months, then the seller connects again.
howToGet: In User Tokens on developer.ebay.com, add an eBay redirect URL (RuName) for the keyset if it has none.
Choose Get a Token from eBay via Your Application, tick only sell.fulfillment.readonly under OAuth scopes, and sign in as the store's seller account to agree.
Copy the refresh token straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
Set a reminder to connect again before the 18 months are up.

entries.name: EBAY_ENVIRONMENT
entries.description: production (the default) or sandbox, which eBay the keys and token belong to. Not a secret.
howToGet: Leave it unset for the store's real eBay account. Set it to sandbox to test with sandbox keys and a sandbox test user.
